:::{#exr-affine-offset-practice}
#### Reading off the offset of an affine map

In a fitted model,
the [offset](#def-affine-offset) is the part of the output that does not depend on the input.
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals^2$ be the [affine map](#def-affine-map)

$$
f(\vx) = (x_1 - x_2 + 4,\ 3 x_2 - 1).
$$

Find the [offset of $f$](#def-affine-offset).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Write $f(\vx)$ as $\matr{A}\vx + \vec{b}$ as in @def-affine-map.

:::

:::
